title: trackerMarkdownImages
responsibility: Finds the images a markdown document names and resolves which of them are image files inside its repository.

inputs.name: trackerMarkdownImages.markdown
inputs.description: The document text; images inside fenced code are ignored.

inputs.name: trackerRepositoryImage.documentPath
inputs.description: The repository path of the document, against which relative sources resolve.

inputs.name: trackerRepositoryImage.source
inputs.description: The image source exactly as the document wrote it.

outputs.name: trackerMarkdownImages
outputs.description: Each named image source once, from markdown and img tags.

outputs.name: trackerRepositoryImage
outputs.description: The repository path and media type, or null for a web address, a path outside the repository, a malformed escape or another file type.
